description: Codex: Orks (11e) Wreckas — WRECKIN' AND LOOTIN' (WP-O34): in your Shooting phase a Breaka Boyz/Flash Gitz/Tankbustas unit re-rolls hit rolls of 1 if it, or its target, is within range of an objective. Setup: detachment Wreckas; Custodian Guard Charlie moved onto the No Man's Land objective at 10",22". Shooting phase: the Flash Gitz are clicked, Quick-Assign at Custodian Guard Charlie, Confirm, Fast: the hit roll's modifier ledger names Wreckin' and Lootin' (re-roll 1s) and every unmodified 1 was re-rolled.

steps.comment: setup privilege: the fixture's Ork detachment is switched to Wreckas (stratagems + detachment rules reloaded)

steps.equals: Wreckin' and Lootin' (target within range of an objective)

steps.comment: Wreckin' and Lootin' in the hit roll's ledger
